title: Secure Application .NET dual-mode vulnerability detection has a realm qualification
problem: November 12 adds runtime vulnerability detection for supported .NET dual-mode applications. The language guide limits it to active AWS realms with Secure Application and explicitly excludes GCP. .NET 8, 9 and 10 and one security signal path are documented, without exact AWS realm IDs, attack-detection support or authorization. Coordinate the report presentation with Release Watch.

exclusions: Actual tenant behavior and broader product and authorization scope remain unverified.

impact.customerScenario: A team plans to use the November 12 .NET dual-mode security milestone in an Observability realm.
impact.consequence: The language guide excludes GCP and restricts AWS to active realms where Secure Application is available. The specific AWS realm must be verified.

confidence.rationale: The official language guide explicitly states both realm conditions.

lifecycle.reason: The scope remains relevant to deployment planning.
